subject: Publisher onboarding: identity claims + technical validation next steps
messages:

To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Marketplace onboarding: publisher account + technical checklist

Hi Karthik / Marissa,

Thanks for taking this on — we want to move Contoso's AI Suite onto the Azure Marketplace and start the co-sell enablement soon. We already have an existing partner registration but need help with: 

- Publisher identity proofing steps (tenant / org claims)
- The required offer JSON (we have a draft) and where to include ARM templates for SaaS plan provisioning
- Technical validation gates for the publisher onboarding SLA

Attaching a small spreadsheet with contact and account details. Can we get a clear checklist and an estimated timeline for initial validation + co-sell readiness?

Cheers,
Sarah Dunne
Program Lead, Contoso Cloud Partnerships
Attachment: contoso-publisher-details.xlsx (stated file stub)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Sarah Dunne <sarah.dunne@contoso.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-25T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding: publisher account + technical checklist

Hi Sarah — thanks for the details and the sheet. We can take point on guidance and technical validation. High level next steps from our side: 

1) Publisher identity proofing
   - We need the Contoso tenant ID (GUID) and the publisher contact listed in the portal.
   - If you want a managed publisher flow, share the org MDN and a screenshot of the Azure AD verified domain.

2) Offer payload / manifest
   - I'll attach our offer template (redwood-azure-offer-template.json) — please fill in the `publisherId`, `planId`, and include the ARM template link if you have a provisioning flow.

3) Technical validation checklist (what our team will validate)
   - Ability to deploy the ARM template (if SaaS, verify provisioning endpoint and health-check URL)
   - SSO / OAuth app reg proof (screenshot of app registration + reply URL)
   - Telemetry endpoint reachable from Azure validation tools (we'll provide a test probe)

4) Co-sell readiness items (brief)
   - Transactable plan details, pricing, and marketplace listing assets
   - Required commercial contacts for co-sell onboarding

Proposed timeline: please return tenant & manifest within 3 business days and we can run technical validation within 48 hours of receiving the complete package.

I attached the offer template and included a short checklist in the doc. If you like, we can book a 30-min tech sync tomorrow afternoon.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Partner Engineering, Redwood Inference
redwood-inference.com
Attachment: redwood-azure-offer-template.json (stated file stub)

From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, Sarah Dunne <sarah.dunne@contoso.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-25T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding: publisher account + technical checklist

Adding a couple of technical notes from the validation perspective: 

- ARM template guidance: include `schema` version and make sure the `deployment` outputs expose a `provisioningStatus` endpoint we can poll. If you have a sandbox subscription, give us a short-lived access key for validation so we don't exhaust quotas.

- SaaS offers: we validate the tenant ownership claim by checking the verified domain and the publisher contact is an owner in Azure AD. If Contoso uses multi-tenant app model, please provide the app id and the redirect URIs.

- Security proofs: for co-sell, Microsoft often wants evidence of basic security hygiene (privileged access model, contact for incident response). We don't need a full SOC report to start, but sample docs help speed the process.

I can take point on the ARM test run once we have the filled-in offer JSON and a sandbox subscription to deploy to. Suggested timeslot for the tech sync: 2026-06-25 15:00 PT.

—Soojin
Senior Technical Program Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachment: (none)
